mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_resource_acl WHERE resource_kind=#{kind} AND resource_id=#{id} AND deleted=0
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_dataset_policy WHERE dataset_id=#{id} AND deleted=0
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_object_grant WHERE dataset_id=#{id} AND object_id=#{object} AND deleted=0
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_object_grant WHERE dataset_id=#{id} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY object_id

WITH definitions AS ( SELECT draft_json AS content FROM public.nocode_report_dataset WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 UNION ALL SELECT definition_json FROM public.nocode_report_dataset_version WHERE dataset_id=#{id} AND deleted=0 ), objects AS ( SELECT content #>> '{source,root,objectId}' AS id FROM definitions UNION SELECT relation #>> '{target,objectId}' FROM definitions, jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(content #> '{source,relations}','[]'::jsonb)) relation UNION SELECT object_id::text FROM public.nocode_report_object_grant WHERE dataset_id=#{id} AND deleted=0 ) SELECT id FROM objects WHERE id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_report_resource_acl(resource_kind,resource_id,policy_json,creator,updater) VALUES(#{kind},#{id},CAST(#{json} AS jsonb),#{actor},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(resource_kind,resource_id) DO UPDATE SET policy_json=excluded.policy_json, lock_version=nocode_report_resource_acl.lock_version+1,deleted=0,updater=excluded.updater,update_time=clock_timestamp()

INSERT INTO public.nocode_report_dataset_policy(dataset_id,members_json,creator,updater) VALUES(#{id},CAST(#{json} AS jsonb),#{actor},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(dataset_id) DO UPDATE SET members_json=excluded.members_json, lock_version=nocode_report_dataset_policy.lock_version+1,deleted=0,updater=excluded.updater,update_time=clock_timestamp()

INSERT INTO public.nocode_report_object_grant(dataset_id,object_id,grant_json,reason,creator,updater) VALUES(#{id},#{object},CAST(#{json} AS jsonb),#{reason},#{actor},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(dataset_id,object_id) DO UPDATE SET grant_json=excluded.grant_json,reason=excluded.reason, lock_version=nocode_report_object_grant.lock_version+1,deleted=0,updater=excluded.updater,update_time=clock_timestamp()
